{{Top|leg|canon=Occupation of Thisspias}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
An '''insurrection''' was mounted by members of the [[Thisspiasian/Legends|Thisspiasian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thisspias/Legends|Thisspias]] at some point during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The insurrection was quickly subdued by the superior firepower of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial forces]] on Thisspias.<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>
